title: events/types/mutation.triggered
description: Payload for event_type 'mutation.triggered' (feature 016; FR-1402/1410): a live-mutation reflection pass fired — cadence boundary, goal failure, or near-failure signal. Records the trigger reason and the evidence that fired it.

reason.description: cadence = every goals_per_pass terminal goals; failure = goal reached failed|expired; near_failure = requeue/escalate/refusal/blocked/defect signal.

evidence.description: What fired it: task ids, transition reasons, defect classes, counters — compact, no CoT.

poll.description: Poll index in the live run that evaluated the trigger.
